title_zh: 先索取记忆研究的同意说明

scenario.label_zh: 先索取记忆研究的同意说明
scenario.goal_zh: 核对研究活动和录音选择，并决定先阅读同意说明而不立即报名

context_zh: 虚构大学研究招募：成年人询问一项记忆研究，不涉及诊断或治疗。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: What would I actually do in the memory study?

sentences.speaker: Researcher
sentences.text: You'd complete some cognitive tasks, such as remembering a short list of pictures. This isn't a medical assessment.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: The poster mentions recording. Is that required?

sentences.speaker: Researcher
sentences.text: Audio recording is optional. The consent form separates that choice from taking part in the tasks.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Could you send me the form before I decide?

sentences.speaker: Researcher
sentences.text: Of course. I'll email the information sheet and the blank form. You don't need to sign up today.

sentences.speaker: Priya
sentences.text: Thanks. I'll read those first and contact you if I want to take part.
